description: Switch a VPS to another plan IN PLACE — files and the OS are kept; the server reboots once (~1 min). `target_plan` = product_id from get_upgrade_options. The prorated difference is charged from the prepaid balance right away (402 with needed/balance if it is short — top up and retry); convert_to_nat refunds the unused difference to the balance. The next renewal uses the new price. Same function as the cabinet's Upgrade panel. Set `confirm: true`. Requires: token + balance for the prorated difference + confirm: true. Typical errors: 402 (top up), 422 not an upgrade (pick from get_upgrade_options).

confirm.description: Must be true — you agree to the charge and one reboot.

service_id.description: Service code as returned by list_vps/order_vps, e.g. "68J67T5" (a plain numeric id is also accepted).

name: change_plan
title: Change VPS plan (resize / convert)
